subject: accounting
objective: Break-even with the contribution margin written as a rate in the brief
instruction: A print shop in a mid-sized city sells stationery. The selling price is 25 USD per box and the variable cost is 15 USD per box, which is a contribution margin of 40 per cent of the selling price. Fixed costs for the month are 18000 USD. Required: report the break-even quantity in boxes, the contribution margin per box, the contribution margin ratio, and the break-even revenue for the month.
